summaryZh: Feist 实验室研究微生物如何适应环境，并将进化过程用于菌株工程与生物技术应用。团队采用自动化适应性实验室进化、基因组分析及基因组尺度建模，识别改善生长、耐受性和产量的有益突变，并将基因型与表型联系起来。
researchQuestions: 微生物如何适应，哪些突变能改善生长、耐受性和产量？

evidence.quote: Feist Lab Principal Investigator: Adam Feist

We use adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE), a type of evolutionary engineering, to improve microbial strains by letting organisms evolve under controlled conditions. Combining automation, experimental design, and genomic analysis, we identify beneficial mutations that enhance growth, tolerance, production, and more across diverse organisms.
genome-scale models and omics connect genotype to phenotype and turn data into predictions.
Lab Locations San Diego, CA University of California San Diego Copenhagen, Denmark Technical University of Denmark
